paragraphs.source_en: As long as a company owns the position, there's no point in running ads that scream, "We're No. 1." Much better is to enhance the product category in the prospect's mind. Notice IBM advertising usually ignores competition and sells the value of computers. All computers, not just the company's types. Why isn't it a good idea to run advertising that says, "We're No. 1"? The reason is pyschological. Either the prospect knows you are No. 1 and wonders why you are so insecure that you have to say so. Or the prospect doesn't know you are No. 1. If not, why not? Maybe you have defined your leadership in your own terms and not the prospect's terms. Unfortunately, that just won't work.
